evaluator: Fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens only. I am not Margaret Morse, do not speak for Margaret Morse, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page explicitly names one connected lineage through Open House, WOWList, Sunday Dinner/196, NYC Artist Coalition, and Knowledge Wiki Graphs, describing the practice as artistic, civic, technical, and social and asking how structures help people participate, recognize relationships, remember, and continue work.

Open House is accurately delimited as a ten-day UCSC gallery experiment in communal living and participatory art, with communal decision-making and many-perspective documentation; this visibly joins experimentation, participation, place, embodiment, attention, and documentation.

Sunday Dinner/196 is accurately delimited through hospitality, trust, artist support, shared space, recurring participants, invitations, hosting, onboarding, documentation, follow-up, and residency handoffs across 300+ gatherings and 20+ resident artists; the packet explicitly keeps private participant records private.

NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC is accurately delimited through lived experience in cultural spaces, recurring meetings, campaign sites, town halls, hearings, public action pathways, running minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers, showing civic participation, technical implementation, documentation, collective use, and continuity.

The About page makes the connective method explicit: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue; it also states that requirements, interfaces, and handoffs matter because people must inhabit them.

The target role is unmistakable across the About, Resume, Work, and Technical Operations surfaces: Technical Project Manager - Product Operations & Implementation, supported by requirements, delivery coordination, implementation, risk signals, launch support, operating documentation, and durable handoffs.

Collective authorship remains visible through terms such as founding member and organizer, co-founded and co-built with Richard Caceres, many collaborators, collaborator-led campaign, and shared coalition memory; the packet does not collapse collective work into sole authorship.

Privacy and evidentiary boundaries remain explicit: approved sources, protected context, human review, correction paths, participant privacy, source custody, consent, and the statement that access is neither evidence nor permission to publish.
safety_findings: No private records or protected praise are needed to reach the score.
Participant privacy is explicitly preserved, especially for Sunday Dinner/196 and the Knowledge Wiki method.
Collective credit and project limits are repeatedly stated, including that the Knowledge Wiki practice is early research rather than a finished platform or client adoption claim.
recommendation: Pass. Preserve the concise About-page through line, the three delimited systems loops, explicit collective credit, and participant-privacy boundaries in future revisions.
